text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The Nippon Derby... The race that decides 
the pinnacle of the Classic tier.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"The title every Umamusume dreams of: 
Derby Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right in front of everyone gathered here 
today. I'm going to prove who I am...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Try not to get too hasty.
Try not to get too hasty, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't pour cold water on this.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Can't you tell just by looking? I'm 
totally hyped right now. Don't kill my 
vibe.
choice_data_list:
Reputations aren't something you can 
overturn all at once.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? If you couldn't change it at the 
Derby, then it's already impossible.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Geez, as my Trainer, isn't there something 
else you should be saying...? Wait, I've 
told you this before, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You want to become one too, don't you? A 
Derby Trainer, that is?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, say something to hype 
me up right now!
choice_data_list:
Go run your own race with everything 
you've got!

Go run with all your might, just the way 
you are!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Duh! Next time I talk to you—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Not City the model, but City the Derby 
Umamusume!
